rationale: Third party (neighbor's child) suffered bodily injury on the policyholder's premises due to an icy walkway condition, creating premises liability.
claim_summary: Neighbor's 9-year-old daughter slipped and fell on policyholder's icy walkway during last week's ice storm, sustaining a broken wrist. Parents are anticipating medical bills. Policy POL-1002 has $500,000 liability coverage with $1,000 deductible.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.injury_description: broke wrist from slip and fall
